title: domain/invoice.py — pure invoice arithmetic functions
scope: Four pure functions using decimal.Decimal only. (1) compute_line_total(quantity: int, unit_price: Decimal) → Decimal: (Decimal(quantity) * unit_price).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), ROUND_HALF_UP); raises ValueError if quantity<=0 or unit_price<0. (2) compute_invoice_total(line_totals: list[Decimal]) → Decimal: sum(line_totals).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), ROUND_HALF_UP); raises ValueError if list is empty. (3) compute_invoice_status(total_amount: Decimal, paid_amounts: list[Decimal]) → Literal['PENDING','PARTIAL','PAID']: paid_sum=sum(paid_amounts); if paid_sum==0 → 'PENDING'; elif paid_sum>=total_amount → 'PAID'; else → 'PARTIAL'. (4) generate_invoice_number(invoice_date: date, sales_header_id: int) → str: f'INV-{invoice_date.strftime("%Y%m%d")}-{sales_header_id:05d}'. No I/O, no SQLAlchemy, no HTTP.
